versions.changelog: Rebuilt every building on the national property register's surveyed floor counts, replacing the modelled heights the maps shipped with — buildings and their tunnel-clearance foundations now stand at registered height — and moved commute origins onto the 2021 census's measured eldership employment instead of a working-age proxy.

Fixed water shattering at low zoom, where simplification had fattened narrow streams into slivers far wider than the real watercourse, and rebalanced demand-point detail so mid-density residential areas hold consistent detail while city centres keep full resolution.
Made commute routing deterministic for consistent, reproducible commuting flows that drop occasional implausibly-long trips.
Added hospital and military-base demand to the Lithuanian maps, refreshed Estonian and Latvian road networks, and fixed workplace counts and over-drawn foundations.
Added the first Lithuanian maps — Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda, Šiauliai, and Panevėžys — with census-based residents, workers, foundation depth, and a full range of demand points.
